For this screen, I highly recomend driver level integer-scaling at 2X 600p on global, this base resolution will fully saturate a 1200p screen under 14 inches easily, and lool beautiful, and even though you get zero fidelity loss, you gain twice the FPS, its amazing how good it looks, even more so thanks to the much high 1 percent frames, whivh gives you a much better motion resolution, and better frame-times, resulting in much better gameplay quality, and for many games, even a 400p base resolution at 3X 400p integer-scale is plenty, for 3X FPS, this is my favourite screen setup for 1200p sub 14 inch OLED displays, and will easily manage a locked 144 FPS on the 144Hz OLED display without stutter or jitter in games like DOOM Eternal or Shadow of the Tomb Raider, I even have a 4X 300p integer-scale preset for many simple graphival games or retro style indie games, which gives me 3 to 4 times the battery life in games like Steamworld Dig 1/2 or Shovel Knight.
